targetText: The conditions of direct exploitation and those of the realisation of surplus value are not identical. They are separated logically as well as by time and space. The first are only limited by the productive power of society, the last by the proportional relations of the various lines of production and by the consuming power of society.
summary: Quoting Marx's Capital Vol. 3, Bukharin explains how depressed working-class consumption forces monopolies to seek foreign sales markets.
explanation: Because capitalism restricts the purchasing power of the domestic working masses while expanding mass production, monopolies are driven to dump surplus commodities abroad and annex colonial markets.
